Name: Clare of Assisi
Summary: Noblewoman of Assisi who followed Francis, founded the Poor Clares, and lived in enclosed poverty at San Damiano.
Contribution: She created a contemplative community for women on Franciscan principles and was the first woman to write a monastic rule, insisting on the privilege of poverty against pressure to accept property and income.
Testimony: She fled her family home to join Francis and held fast to a life of poverty and prayer to the end of her life.
